# lean-browser-use

> Cut browser use cost by about 25% in Claude Code: fresh runner subagent, bulk reads, three guards and a token meter. One npx command

Install: `npx lean-browser-use`

Two measured runs cost 3.15% and 25.26% less with the package at list API prices, about 14.02% less pooled. About 25% cheaper is the rounded best of those two runs on one setup. Savings vary with model, task and session size; measure your own transcripts. A browser step re-reads about 3x fewer tokens per browser step. Everything run 1 read totalled 2,657,290 tokens in the plain arm and 2,846,792 in the runner arm: about 7% higher overall. Model, task and session size affect cost. The rough token break-even of about 16 browser steps is an estimate.
